notes.title: Balance Update
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]With this update, I wanted to bring some much-needed balancing to the game. I apologize for the long delay between the translation update and this one, but I had to prioritize other projects and personal matters.[/p][p][/p][p]Here are the patch notes:[/p][list][*][p]Increased the default computer storage space from 10 to 30.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the storage space provided by upgrades (50, 70, 100).[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the price of computer upgrades (40, 70, 80).[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the Wi-Fi detection increase rate.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the probability of phishing contracts appearing to allow for more variety.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you all once again for your support.[/p][p]Happy hacking![/p]

notes.title: Translation update
notes.content: [p]Hi,[/p][p][/p][p]It’s been a very long time since the last update, as I had to prioritise other work.[/p][p][/p][h2]Translation[/h2][p]The main focus of this update is translations into the following languages:[/p][list][*][p]French[/p][/*][*][p]Italian[/p][/*][*][p]German[/p][/*][*][p]Spanish[/p][/*][*][p]Polish[/p][/*][*][p]Brazilian Portuguese[/p][/*][*][p]Japanese[/p][/*][*][p]Korean[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified Chinese[/p][/*][*][p]Russian[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I’ve added a [b]Language[/b] option under [b]Settings > Graphics[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]I’ve created a “[b]Translation Bugs[/b]” thread on the Steam forums. If you encounter any issues with the translations, please post there and I’ll fix them.[/p][p][/p][h2]Other changes[/h2][p]This update also includes the following changes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed FOV on ultra wide resolutions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Main menu and Pause menu on ultra wide resolutions[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced nmap delay[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced download/upload delay[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced crypto gains from mining rigs[/p][/*][*][p]Increased crypto gains from contracts[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support and happy hacking![/p]

notes.title: Major Reworks, Bug fixes, New Task Bar feature, and some explanations!
notes.content:
[h2]Some explanations:[/h2]

Hello everyone,

Before anything, I want to inform you that I've finally [u]fixed the most important issues[/u]! You will find the list at the bottom.

Secondly, [u]I've started working on the translation[/u] and I will do my best to deliver it as soon as I can.

And last but not least, [u]I want to apologize for the complete lack of updates[/u]. I will give some explanations below:

I've read almost all your feedbacks since I've published the game and I knew for a long time that it had issues. In reality, I couldn't find the time and the energy to open the project after all this time because I knew how the code was. Hacker Simulator is my very first project and I didn't had the experience that I have today when I worked on it. We can't really tell by just looking at the game, but the code is a mess and I found it very difficult to go back to it and understand it all.

Today it's a completely different story. Every person who has bought the game has contributed to giving me the opportunity to use my time to learn everything I've learned so far, and [b]I can't thank you enough[/b]. 

I've learned so much, from game design, core principles of game development, to being able to understand most of the multiplayer principles for example, and I intend to use this knowledge to bring you some fun experiences in my next titles!

Finally, here is the patch note:

[h2]Patch note:[/h2]

[h3]New task bar feature[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a task bar functionality to the computer, allowing us to keep shortcuts to the windows we open and to minimize/restore them as we want.
It will make the navigation a lot easier!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExYWk5cGQwb3c1eWg0ZHI4Y25ldG55aDRoazNrMXVrdXBxNDJzOHVsZCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/BQbBttqZDTv5DXwjqa/giphy.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h3]User Interface[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reworked the User Interface so it is now responsive to every screen resolutions.
[*] Fixed an issue where the User Interface sometimes had some offset, completely preventing us to interact with it. (The call from the beginning for example...)
[*] Fixed an issue where the game resolution was still the same after starting the game on a different monitor.
[/list]

[h3]Main and Pause Menus[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reworked the Main Menu and the Pause Menu so it is responsive to every screen resolutions.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Main Menu was not scaled correctly after a resolution change, preventing us to interact with it unless we removed our setting save file.
[/list]

[h3]Window dragging functionality[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reworked the window dragging functionality.
[*] Fixed an issue where clicking on the header bar of a window was not correctly detected, preventing us to drag windows.
[/list]

[h3]Focus on terminal windows[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reworked the focus on terminal windows so we are now able to focus on them by clicking anywhere in them, and not only on the command line!
[*] Fixed an issue where we could focus on a terminal window only by clicking its header bar.
[/list]

notes.title: Update _ Auto Complete Feature
notes.content:
Hello!

As the title indicates, this update brings a very often requested feature: the [b]Auto Complete[/b]. Its operation is simple: complete your entries in the terminal using the Tab key! Quite effective, isn't it?

I would also like to specify that I am [u]not[/u] leaving Hacker Simulator to be abandoned as it could be mentioned, and that other updates are to come!

I hope you enjoy this update, and I invite you to join our community on the [b]Save All Studio[/b] Discord server at https://discord.gg/eNDDEyxBE9

Have fun!

🔹 Adjusted mamazon items prices.
🔹 Reduced the scansystem/scanfolder delay from 2 seconds to 1 second.
🔹 Added a picture of the "Wifi Meter" in the Wifi Cracking tutorial popup.
